passages.text: Reference is made throughout this Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations to Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements , which begin on page 29 of this report. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations for 2023 is included in Item 7 of the company’s 2024 Annual Report on Form 10-K filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The company refers to various amounts or measures not prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles (non-GAAP measures). These non-GAAP measures are further described and reconciled to their most directly comparable amount or measure under the section “ Non-GAAP Measures ” later in this “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations.” Amounts and percentages reported within this Annual Report on Form 10-K are presented and calculated based on underlying unrounded amounts. As a result, the sum of components may not equal corresponding totals due to rounding. Overview Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. enables customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer by helping them accelerate life sciences research, solve complex analytical challenges, increase laboratory productivity, and improve patient health through diagnostics and the development and manufacture of life-changing therapies. Markets served include pharmaceutical and biotech, academic and government, industrial and applied, as well as healthcare and diagnostics. The company’s operations fall into four segments (Note 11): Life Sciences Solutions, Analytical Instruments, Specialty Diagnostics, and Laboratory Products and Biopharma Services. 19 THERMO FISHER SCIENTIFIC INC. passages.text: Set forth below are the risks, some of which have occurred and any of which may occur in the future, that we believe are material to our investors. This section contains forward-looking statements. You should refer to the explanation of the qualifications and limitations on forward-looking statements in Item 1. Business under the caption “Forward-looking Statements”. Industry and Economic Risks Our growth would be impacted if the markets into which we sell our products and services decline, do not grow as anticipated or experience cyclicality. Our growth depends in part on the growth of the markets which we serve. Any decline or lower than expected growth in our served markets would diminish demand for our products and services, which would adversely affect our financial statements. Certain of our businesses operate in industries that may experience periodic, cyclical downturns. Our business is affected by general economic conditions and related uncertainties affecting markets in which we operate. Our business is affected by general economic conditions, both inside and outside the U.S. Both domestic and international markets experienced significant inflationary pressures in 2025 and inflation rates in the U.S., as well as in other countries in which we operate, continue at elevated levels. If the global economy and financial markets, or economic conditions in Europe, the U.S. or other key markets, are unstable, that could adversely affect the business, results of operations and financial condition of the company and its customers, distributors, and suppliers, having the effect of: • reducing demand for some of our products and services; • increasing the rate of order cancellations or delays; • increasing the risk of excess and obsolete inventories; • increasing pressure on the prices for our products and services; • causing supply interruptions, which could disrupt our ability to produce our products; and • creating longer sales cycles, and greater difficulty in collecting sales proceeds and slower adoption of new technologies. 9 THERMO FISHER SCIENTIFIC INC. Economic, political, foreign currency and other risks associated with international sales and operations could adversely affect our results of operations. International markets contribute a substantial portion of our revenues, and we intend to continue expanding our presence in these regions. The exposure to fluctuations in currency exchange rates takes on different forms. International revenues and costs are subject to the risk that fluctuations in exchange rates could adversely affect our reported revenues and profitability when translated into U.S. dollars for financial reporting purposes. These fluctuations could also adversely affect the demand for products and services provided by us. As a multinational corporation, our businesses occasionally invoice third-party customers in currencies other than the one in which they primarily do business (which we refer to as the functional currency). credit_strengths.text: Thermo Fisher's revenue base is highly diversified across life sciences, analytical instruments, diagnostics and biopharma services, with recurring consumables and pharma demand driving growth. Operating margin is solid and has expanded modestly, supporting stable internal cash generation through economic cycles.

Operating cash flow comfortably covers capital expenditure, producing free cash flow that funds dividends, buybacks and acquisitions. The company retains substantial cash balances, and its current ratio exceeds the sector median, indicating ample near-term liquidity.

key_risks.text: The company's risk factors highlight exposure to cyclical market declines, inflationary pressures and international currency fluctuations. A meaningful portion of revenues is generated outside the U.S., and adverse movements in exchange rates or economic conditions in key markets such as China could pressure reported results and cash flows.

The debt note shows a large concentration of senior notes maturing within the next few years, including several euro, Swiss franc and yen-denominated issues. Refinancing this ladder exposes the company to interest rate and currency risk, particularly if market conditions tighten or credit spreads widen.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage remains adequate, with operating income covering gross interest expense multiple times. However, coverage sits below the sector median, and free cash flow to debt is modest, indicating that debt service consumes a meaningful share of internally generated funds relative to peers.

Net leverage is elevated compared to the sector median, though it remains within an investment-grade range. The maturity profile is well distributed, with no single year requiring outsized repayment, but the company's reliance on refinancing and its ongoing acquisition strategy could strain liquidity if cash flow deteriorates.

overall_credit_view.text: Thermo Fisher's credit profile is supported by a diversified business, consistent profitability and solid free cash flow generation. The indicative financial risk profile is significant, with leverage above the sector median and cash flow coverage below peer levels, but the company retains ample liquidity and a safe Altman Z-score.

We view the credit as stable, with capacity to absorb moderate earnings declines. However, shareholder distributions and acquisitions absorb most free cash flow, limiting deleveraging. A sustained increase in leverage or a deterioration in cash flow coverage could pressure the credit profile, warranting close monitoring.

credit_strengths.text: Thermo Fisher 的收入基礎高度多元化，涵蓋生命科學、分析儀器、診斷及生物製藥服務，經常性消耗品及製藥需求推動增長。營業利潤率穩健，並略有擴張，支持在經濟週期中產生穩定的內部現金流。
經營現金流足以覆蓋資本開支，產生自由現金流以支持股息、回購及收購。公司持有大量現金結餘，流動比率高於行業中位數，顯示短期流動性充裕。

key_risks.text: 公司的風險因素凸顯其面臨週期性市場下滑、通脹壓力及國際貨幣波動的風險。相當部分收入來自美國以外地區，匯率或主要市場（如中國）經濟狀況的不利變動，可能對報告業績及現金流構成壓力。
債務票據顯示大量優先票據將於未來數年內到期，包括若干以歐元、瑞士法郎及日圓計價的發行。為此到期階梯再融資使公司面臨利率及貨幣風險，尤其是若市場環境收緊或信貸息差擴闊。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率仍然充足，營業收入覆蓋總利息支出的倍數較高。然而，覆蓋率低於行業中位數，且自由現金流對債務的比率適中，顯示債務償付佔內部產生資金的比例相對同業而言較大。
淨槓桿相對行業中位數偏高，但仍處於投資級別範圍。到期結構分佈良好，並無任何單一年份需要巨額還款，但公司依賴再融資及其持續收購策略，若現金流惡化，可能對流動性構成壓力。

overall_credit_view.text: Thermo Fisher 的信貸狀況得到多元化業務、穩定盈利能力及穩健自由現金流產生的支持。指示性財務風險狀況顯著，槓桿高於行業中位數，現金流覆蓋低於同業水平，但公司仍持有充裕流動性及安全的 Altman Z-score。
我們認為信貸狀況穩定，具備吸收適度盈利下滑的能力。然而，股東分派及收購吸收大部分自由現金流，限制去槓桿。槓桿持續上升或現金流覆蓋惡化可能對信貸狀況構成壓力，值得密切監察。
